evidence.interpretation: No matrix/tensor core utilization; matmul runs on regular vector ALUs with lower effective throughput.

fixes.fix: Enable MFMA/tensor-core style Triton matmul path for fp16/bf16 (use HIP-targeted tensor-instruction configs and validate generated ISA uses MFMA).
